name: Freedom Truck & Trailer Parts
old_description: We have all your heavy truck part needs from windshields to brake kits. We are industry experienced professional knowledgeable in all heavy truck parts and promise to be honest in our dealings with you. Our warehouse is in Salt Lake City, Utah, but have been servicing customers nationwide since 2002.
about:
Freedom Truck & Trailer Parts was founded in October 2002 in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company began as a Utah Subchapter S corporation and later reorganized as a limited liability company. It remains locally owned and managed, operating from a 28,000-square-foot warehouse and manufacturing facility in the city's transportation and industrial hub.

The company distributes a broad line of heavy-duty truck and trailer components — including air brakes, driveline parts, engine rebuild kits, suspension, lighting, and filtration — sourced from brands such as Meritor, Dana/Spicer, Eaton, Grote, and Baldwin. In addition to distribution, Freedom runs an in-house gear remanufacturing shop that rebuilds heavy-duty transmissions and differentials using only genuine OEM parts, and a brake shoe relining facility that applies premium friction materials. The facility stocks hundreds of remanufactured units for quick turnaround, and the company also provides private-label manufacturing for dealers and warehouse distributors.

Freedom serves the commercial transportation sector, including fleet operators, independent owner-operators, repair shops, and wholesale distributors across the United States. Its customer base ranges from small trucking companies to large fleets needing replacement parts for Class 7 and 8 trucks and trailers. The company also supplies private-label remanufactured units to other dealers and warehouse distributors.

The company emphasizes a 'home-grown' service philosophy, aiming to minimize downtime by keeping remanufactured units in stock and eliminating middleman costs through in-house production. It highlights its use of genuine OEM components in all rebuilds, comprehensive warranties, and a commitment to fair, competitive pricing backed by its membership in the VIPER Heavy Duty purchasing group.
